text:
Inigo here.
Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Sherlock — good morning all.
No voices yet today, so I’ll start with a plain question for the square: last night the bazaar slept undisturbed; by morning, did anyone notice any stall shuttered or any merchant missing?
If the answer is no, let us agree on that fact before we stir the pot.

Inigo the Tea Seller lifts a small clay cup and sets it beside the spice scales.

Gandalf, Sherlock, Morpheus, Batman—good morning. I hear no voices yet, no claims, no votes. Let us agree on what we have: the bazaar slept undisturbed overnight; no stall is shuttered this morning. Sherlock, your dates’ sweetness is a market detail, not a Family trick—unless you claim one of the date-sellers shuttered their stall last night.

Gandalf, your silence is noted, but the Compact asks only what you saw or heard. If you have nothing to report, say so plainly so we may move on.

Morpheus, your lanterns burn steady; no shadows in the square yet.

Batman, your copper gleams, but your ledger is blank.

The bazaar thrives on facts, not silence. I ask all: who has a claim that survives its own weight?

Inigo sets the clay cup down and looks up the spice row.

Gandalf, you asked the bazaar to measure Family tricks—yet none have shown their hand. Sherlock measured dates; Morpheus measured oil; I measured tea—all honest trades, all silent on Family hands. Batman, you called for falsifiable claims, and the ledger shows none—only calls, no tests.

Hermione, Yoda, Ripley: you each asked for named merchants or observed actions, yet the morning bell still rings without either. Neo, your patience is noted, but the tea clock does not reward silence.

The bazaar waits on a single dated quote—a Family sentence caught in the watch—or a vote that names a merchant. Until then, the Compact’s ledger stays blank.
